## By rule

| Rule | Tier | Hits | Files | Why it is wrong |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| `SU-DASH-C` | ERROR | 0 | 0 | UNQUOTED `su -c`. `adb shell` does not preserve quoting, so the local shell strips the quotes and the line reaches the device as separate argv words: `adb shell su -c 'a; b'` runs only `a`, and flags after the command are eaten by `su` -- `su -c magisk -v` prints *su's* version. This is broken on EVERY device and every `su` implementation, which is why it is an ERROR. | <!-- lint:allow -->
| `SU-CONVENTION` | WARN | 383 | 145 | Quoting is correct here, so this is a portability warning rather than a defect. `su -c 'cmd'` is right on a **Magisk** `su` (measured working for `su -c 'pm install'` on this repo's Redmi M2101K6P, Android 11 / API 30) and fatal on **AOSP** `su` (every userdebug build and every AVD), which takes `su <uid> <cmd>` and answers `su: invalid uid/gid '-c'` -- a message that reads as NOT ROOTED. Neither form is universally correct. Say which device the line assumes, or probe both. | <!-- lint:allow -->
| `SU-DASH-C-BARE` | WARN | 432 | 146 | A device-side `su -c`. Correct on a Magisk phone, fatal on an AVD or any AOSP userdebug build, where `su` takes `su <uid> <cmd>`. If the sheet does not say which device it assumes, the reader will run it on the wrong one. | <!-- lint:allow -->
| `ADB-SHELL-NESTED-QUOTES` | ERROR | 0 | 0 | `adb shell sh -c '...'` with the outer command NOT double-quoted. The host shell strips the single quotes, adb re-joins the remaining argv with spaces, and the device shell re-splits. Measured: `adb shell sh -c 'echo A; echo B'` prints a blank line then `B` — the first command is SWALLOWED, with no error and exit 0. | <!-- lint:allow -->
| `MSYS-PATHCONV` | WARN | 122 | 78 | An unquoted absolute DEVICE path after `adb shell`. On Git Bash / MSYS2 the path is rewritten to a HOST path before adb sees it, and the error names a Windows directory, so it reads as an adb or device problem. Measured: `adb shell ls -la /sdcard/` returns `ls: C:/Program: No such file or directory`. Every Android top-level path tested was rewritten EXCEPT `/proc`, which MSYS treats as a virtual mount — so the failure is intermittent across a sheet and looks arbitrary. Harmless on Linux and macOS; this repository is written on Git Bash. | <!-- lint:allow -->
| `EXEC-SHELL-COMMAND-NOT-A-SHELL` | ERROR | 0 | 0 | `UiAutomation.executeShellCommand` is NOT a shell: it splits on whitespace and execs. Measured — `echo "one two"` returns the quote characters, and `getprop \| wc -l` returns nothing AT ALL with no error. It also runs as uid 2000, so a probe routed through it has measured the shell while looking like an in-process measurement. | <!-- lint:allow -->
| `ADB-IN-READ-LOOP` | WARN | 0 | 0 | `adb shell` inherits stdin, so inside a `while read` loop fed by a pipe it consumes the loop's input. Measured: a three-row loop printed ONE row and exited 0, reading exactly like a device with nothing on it. | <!-- lint:allow -->
| `PIPEFAIL-SIGPIPE` | WARN | 34 | 6 | `set -o pipefail` plus an early-exit consumer (`head`, `grep -q`) reports failure ON SUCCESS: the consumer closes the pipe, the writer dies of SIGPIPE, and pipefail promotes 141 to the pipeline's status. Measured 141 for both `yes \| head -3` and `seq 1 100000 \| grep -q 5`. It cost this repository an hour once and printed "not a JNI library" directly below a list of JNI exports another time. | <!-- lint:allow -->
| `XML-COMMENT-DOUBLE-HYPHEN` | WARN | 5 | 5 | `--` inside an XML comment is not well-formed XML and **aapt2 rejects the file**. Five real `.xml` files in this repository hit it, every one because a command-line flag (`--es`, `--uri`, `--brief`) or an em dash was written inside a comment. **Tiered WARN after adjudication, not ERROR:** all five hits in the current markdown are documentation header comments at the top of an `xml` fence (`<!-- path/to/file.xml -- what it is -->`), which break a build only if the reader copies the header into the file too. The rule is cheap and the class is real, so it stays — at the tier the evidence supports. | <!-- lint:allow -->

## Correct forms

| Rule | Ship this instead |
|---|---|
| `SU-DASH-C` | `adb shell "su -c 'a; b'"    # or, on an AVD:  adb shell "su 0 sh -c 'a; b'"` | <!-- lint:allow -->
| `SU-CONVENTION` | `adb shell "su 0 <cmd>"  on an AVD;  keep `su -c` for a Magisk phone` | <!-- lint:allow -->
| `SU-DASH-C-BARE` | `su 0 <cmd>` | <!-- lint:allow -->
| `ADB-SHELL-NESTED-QUOTES` | `adb shell "sh -c 'echo A; echo B'"` | <!-- lint:allow -->
| `MSYS-PATHCONV` | `adb shell 'ls -la /sdcard/'   # quote it; MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 also works` | <!-- lint:allow -->
| `EXEC-SHELL-COMMAND-NOT-A-SHELL` | `executeShellCommand("sh -c 'getprop \| wc -l'")` | <!-- lint:allow -->
| `ADB-IN-READ-LOOP` | `adb shell <cmd> < /dev/null` | <!-- lint:allow -->
| `PIPEFAIL-SIGPIPE` | `grep -c (reads all input), or a shell `case` glob, or drop pipefail` | <!-- lint:allow -->
| `XML-COMMENT-DOUBLE-HYPHEN` | `write the flag without its leading hyphens, or use an en dash` | <!-- lint:allow -->
